source: COMPOSED. Parameter shape from @google/genai v2.27.0 src/types.ts GenerateContentParameters / GenerateContentConfig (responseMimeType, responseJsonSchema — 'If set, response_schema must be omitted, but response_mime_type is required'). The schema is what coax's toProviderSchema() produces for z.object({ title: z.string().min(1), tags: z.array(z.string()).min(1), kind: z.literal("article") }) per the Zod 4.4.3 processors (node_modules/zod/v4/core/json-schema-processors.js) — note `const` and `minLength`, which are NOT in Google's supported keyword list (see decisions/stage-01-facts.md §4).
